entities.summary: Martin Zobel is an Estonian plant ecologist and professor at the University of Tartu. His name is particularly associated with the idea of an impact of regional species diversity on diversity at smaller spatial scales – known as the species pool effect. He has been professor since 1992. He has served as Editor-in-Chief of the scientific journal Ecography. Martin Zobel was a logicians & mathematicians from Tallinn (b. 1957-02-25, Tallinn). Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
